switches.off: off; zero overlay, semantic, diagnostic and editor work
switches.auto: active only with admitted resolved package or sourced gem evidence; no evidence means inactive
switches.on: explicit admitted release without dependency evidence; never overrides unsupported installed evidence

independence: Never derive turbo from stimulus or stimulus from turbo. Each record has its own state, release, provenance and switch. A pair of gems yields two records, not a Hotwire aggregate.
conflict: Contradictory resolved package/gem releases cannot be guessed into one profile; retain provenance and refuse admission until FWA1 has an unambiguous exact release.
files: FWA1 supplies per-package/per-file records; INT5 finds embedded regions. The overlay consumes neutral HWC facts and never activates from attribute spelling.
